name: Cable Seated Crunch
steps: Place a bench facing away from a high pulley with a rope attached.
Sit upright with feet planted and hold one rope end beside each temple.
Exhale and curl your rib cage down toward your lap while keeping your hips seated.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, then uncurl slowly until you sit tall again.
tips: Keep your hands fixed beside your temples rather than pulling with your arms.
Flex through your spine instead of hinging forward with a straight back.
